title: Invitation to attend a lecture

body:
The Secretary-General of the Arab Union for Astronomy & Space Sciences and the Regional Office for Astronomy Development in the Arab Region cordially invite you to attend a lecture entitled:

“Earthquakes and Their Risk Limits in the Arab World”

Presented by:

Professor Dr. Najib Abu Karkie
Professor of Geophysics and Seismology at the University of Jordan, Former President of Al-Hussein Bin Talal University.
Date:

Saturday, June 8, 2024
Time:

6:30 PM Mecca time
Location:

In-person at the Union’s headquarters located in the Gardens behind Abu Jbara Restaurants.
Virtual via Zoom:

We are pleased to have you with us!
